title: Model Based Systems Engineering (Digital Thread)
description: Model Based Systems Engineering (Digital Thread) as a design consideration that every design shall address (4.2). Generic framework content.
guidance: Answer each item for the review stage. A No needs an Action, a Risk or a justification approved by the Discipline Lead (4.5). Items are Draft starter content for review.

items.question: Is the FDPS linked to its Requirements and Sub-systems in the model?
Are the installation's functions and interfaces captured in the system model?
Are data owners and master systems identified for each data type used?
Are model links (Requirements, items, Verifications) complete for the preliminary design?
Are parameters that drive the design captured as Parameter records?
Are model and drawing data consistent?
Are all items, links and Compliance Statements of the FDPS held in the Hub and PLM?
Are frozen baselines and snapshots complete for release?
Are Production Links to released documents current?

draft_note: Starter checklist items, Draft: to be reviewed with the framework owner before Framework v1.0 release.
